name: Mystical Elf
extDescription: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

name: Dragon Horn Hunter
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect:
All Normal Monsters gain 200 ATK. You take no battle damage from battles involving Normal Monsters you control.
Monster Text:
The horns were needed to prepare a medicine for her village, suffering from a plague. Unknown to her, the dragons burned and trampled her village, once displaced from their den.

name: Flash Knight
extDescription: The power of the pendulum flashes forth from this shining knight.

name: Foucault's Cannon
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect
Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy it.
Monster Text:
A mechanized life form, roving through space-time. But the mysterious thing is that its memory i... m...stly gone. W...at is t...e reason? D..... refuse t... b.... interfered w...h?

name: Lancephorhynchus
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect
If a Normal Monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.
Monster Text:
This primordial species survived extinction by evolving an offensive lance that can pierce anything, although its diet still consists mainly of fish.

name: Dragoons of Draconia
extDescription:
Pendulum Effect
Once per turn, if a Normal Monster you control destroys an opponent's monster by battle, after damage calculation: You can add 1 Level 4 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.
Monster Text:
Armed with muskets and iron spears, these mounted land troops of the Draconia Empire are feared by the Reptier Kingdom and other bordering nations.

name: Old Vindictive Magician
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Aether, the Empowering Dragon
extDescription: When this card is Pendulum Summoned: You can target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Aether, the Empowering Dragon" once per turn.

name: Blue Dragon Summoner
extDescription: If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 Dragon, Warrior, or Spellcaster Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Battleguard King
extDescription: Once per turn: You can Tribute any number of Warrior-Type monsters, except this card; for each Tributed monster, this card gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

name: Doomstar Magician
extDescription: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card in either player's Pendulum Zone; destroy that card, and if you do, draw 1 card.

name: Dark Hole
extDescription: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Riryoku
extDescription: Target 2 face-up monsters on the field; halve the ATK of 1 monster, and if you do, add that lost ATK to the other monster. These effects last until the End Phase.

name: Nightmare's Steelcage
extDescription: This card remains on the field for 2 of your opponent's turns. While this card is face-up on the field, no monsters can attack.

name: Wonder Wand
extDescription: Equip only to a Spellcaster monster. It gains 500 ATK. If you control the equipped monster and this card: You can send both to the GY; draw 2 cards.

name: Bashing Shield
extDescription: Equip only to a Normal Summoned/Set monster. It gains 1000 ATK. You take no battle damage from attacks involving it.

name: Mirror Force
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

name: Reckless Greed
extDescription: Draw 2 cards and skip your next 2 Draw Phases.

name: Defense Draw
extDescription: During your opponent's turn, at damage calculation: Make the battle damage you take from this battle 0, and if you do, draw 1 card.

name: Inspiration
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn.
